g.text: Title: LightBoard - 4 x LH351D bright white LED driver (MIC4801), 5 V

g.desc: Title: LightBoard - 4 x LH351D bright white LED driver (MIC4801), 5 V

g.text: POWER IN (+5 V, reverse-polarity FET) + EN SELECT (SW1: ON / EXT PWM)

g.desc: POWER IN (+5 V, reverse-polarity FET) + EN SELECT (SW1: ON / EXT PWM)

g.text: LH351D thermal pads are electrically isolated and tied to GND copper for heat spreading.

g.desc: LH351D thermal pads are electrically isolated and tied to GND copper for heat spreading.

g.text: 4 x LH351D + MIC4801 LINEAR CURRENT SINKS (ILED = 4920 / (RSET[k] - 0.14))

g.desc: 4 x LH351D + MIC4801 LINEAR CURRENT SINKS (ILED = 4920 / (RSET[k] - 0.14))

g.text: LightBoard rev A. +5 V ONLY (MIC4801 absolute max 6 V). ~1.4 A at the default 331 mA per LED.

g.desc: LightBoard rev A. +5 V ONLY (MIC4801 absolute max 6 V). ~1.4 A at the default 331 mA per LED.

g.text: Per channel: +5V -> LED -> Rdrop 2.7R -> MIC4801 D1 -> GND. Rdrop takes the headroom the SOIC-8 cannot dissipate.

g.desc: Per channel: +5V -> LED -> Rdrop 2.7R -> MIC4801 D1 -> GND. Rdrop takes the headroom the SOIC-8 cannot dissipate.

g.text: RSET: 15k = 331 mA (default), 10k = 499 mA (bolt to a heatsink), 22k = 225 mA. Rdrop = 0R for a 1-cell Li-ion supply.

g.desc: RSET: 15k = 331 mA (default), 10k = 499 mA (bolt to a heatsink), 22k = 225 mA. Rdrop = 0R for a 1-cell Li-ion supply.

g.text: SW1 ON: EN = +5V via R11. SW1 EXT: EN = J2 PWM via R12 (200 Hz-10 kHz linear; first pulse >= 60 us wakes the MIC4801).

g.desc: SW1 ON: EN = +5V via R11. SW1 EXT: EN = J2 PWM via R12 (200 Hz-10 kHz linear; first pulse >= 60 us wakes the MIC4801).
